summary: Use host runtime lazy OS clipboard reads for ClipboardItems returned by Clipboard.read().

semantics.lazy_read: first getType(type) can initiate OS clipboard data read
semantics.dedup: concurrent same-type calls share the in-flight resolver
semantics.change_count: clipboard changes may invalidate/protect snapshot semantics

tests.name: lazy payload
tests.expected_behavior: payload access occurs at getType boundary rather than necessarily during read metadata creation

tests.name: concurrent calls
tests.expected_behavior: same-type host read is shared rather than duplicated
